start_mixture.proof: M_k is exactly the fixed weighted mixture of all delayed start-specific e-processes, with unstarted components contributing their unit wealth. Therefore it is an e-process whenever each block factor is a conditional e-value.
start_mixture.state: one active scalar per direction plus fixed-size block sufficient statistics; no per-start array

up.null_validity: On the variance-reference event sigma0<=U. Since W/sigma0^2~chi2_d, the exact chi-square mgf gives E[e]<=1, equality at sigma0=U. The factor increases in W.
up.power: For r>=3.4, post std/U>=a; lower-tail power is worst at post std=aU.

down.null_validity: On the variance-reference event sigma0>=L. The coefficient is negative and the exact chi-square mgf gives E[e]<=1, equality at sigma0=L.
down.power: For r<=0.065, post std/L<=a; lower-tail power is worst at post std=aL.

variance_channels.component_failure_formula: For n clean post blocks and start j, b_j=log(1/(0.03*0.25*pi_j)), S_n=-nd log a +(a^2-1) chi2_{nd}/2. Up-failure is the corresponding chi-square lower tail below b_j; down-failure is the upper tail.
variance_channels.interpretation: Seven centered Gaussian residual degrees of freedom per eight raw observations recover most variance information lost by disjoint pair differencing while localizing an arbitrary changepoint to at most one mixed block.

mean_channels.coverage_partition: If r is not outside [0.065,3.4], KL>=1 implies (Delta/sigma0)^2 >= 3+log r-r. This quantity is minimized on the interval at r=0.065, so |Delta|/sigma0 >= sqrt(3+log(0.065)-0.065)=0.4490345... . On the variance-reference event this is |Delta|/U>=0.3905597... .
mean_channels.reference_mean_bounds: M_U=Xbar+z U/sqrt(684), M_L=Xbar-z U/sqrt(684). On the mean and variance reference events M_L<=mu0<=M_U and the selected bound overshoots mu0 by at most 2 z U/sqrt(684)=0.1969786 U.
mean_channels.null_validity: Under no change, the signed normalized block mean has mean<=0 and variance<=1/m, hence the Gaussian mgf gives conditional E[e]<=1.
mean_channels.power_bound: For the correct sign, each clean post-block log factor is Gaussian with mean at least m g^2(c-c^2/2) and variance at most 3.4 m g^2 c^2. Thus P(S_n<b_j) is upper bounded by the corresponding normal CDF exactly from these worst parameters.

expected_delay_upper_numeric_series_raw.note: Uses E[tau]<=sum_n P(S_n<b); numerical series, not interval-certified.

full_coverage.claim: On the two reference-good events, the four fixed-direction block processes cover every fixed iid Gaussian step alternative with D_KL(Q||P)>=1. Variance ratios outside [0.065,3.4] are caught by the variance channels; inside that interval the KL inequality forces the stated signed mean-shift floor.
full_coverage.typeI: Each direction/start component is a conditional e-process; fixed mixtures over starts and directions remain an e-process. Ville gives conditional PFA<=0.03, and union with the two 0.01 reference-event failures gives unconditional PFA<=0.05.
full_coverage.scope: Gaussian iid clean reference and one fixed Gaussian post-change law; deterministic block boundaries. No heavy-tail, serial-dependence, gradual-drift, or repeated-change claim.

comparison_negative: The r81 Gaussian p-to-e pair channel is no longer needed for the variance branches once the exact reference variance confidence set is available: direct likelihood e-factors are simpler and stronger, especially for variance decreases.

A single likelihood process started at monitoring time can decay before a late change. The weighted delayed-start mixture is essential. Because block factors are common across starts, the infinite mixture collapses exactly to O(1) state per direction.

The first-start r77 terminal t/F sentinel remains a strong early companion: it had a <=0.07117 miss bound over all Gaussian KL>=1 by at most a 16-sample gap plus 48 post samples, whereas the new block detector is designed primarily to give nonshrinking late-start PFA-safe coverage.
Reported quantiles and delay integers are float64/scipy evaluations of exact symbolic formulas, not directed-rounding interval certificates.

public_sources.use: Start-specific e-process sums/mixtures and the PFA rule for initial weights summing to at most one; PFA-safe delay typically grows logarithmically with changepoint time.

public_sources.use: Conditional e-values multiply into test supermartingales/e-processes and Ville thresholding gives anytime type-I control.
